comment: Every source the graph is built from. `just fetch` downloads each one into data/raw/<target> and checks its SHA-256. A source with "manual": true needs a login: the fetch prints the steps instead. See docs/data-sources.md for what each source contributes and its licence.

sources.name: kaggle
sources.title: The Holy Quran Dataset (Kaggle, yasirabdaali)
sources.licence: CC0 on Kaggle; the Arabic is Tanzil's text and the English is Qara'i's translation

sources.name: tanzil-metadata
sources.title: Tanzil Quran metadata (surahs, juz, hizb, manzil, ruku, page, sajda)
sources.licence: Tanzil, CC BY 3.0 — attribute and link to tanzil.net

sources.name: tanzil-uthmani
sources.title: Tanzil Quran text, Uthmani script (display)
sources.licence: Tanzil, CC BY 3.0 — verbatim copies only, keep the notice

sources.name: tanzil-simple-clean
sources.title: Tanzil Quran text, Simple-Clean (standard spelling, no diacritics: search and embeddings)
sources.licence: Tanzil, CC BY 3.0 — verbatim copies only, keep the notice

sources.name: translation-qarai
sources.title: English translation by Ali Quli Qara'i (Tanzil copy, without the footnotes)
sources.licence: Tanzil translations: non-commercial use, with attribution

sources.name: translation-sahih
sources.title: English translation, Saheeh International (Tanzil copy)
sources.licence: Tanzil translations: non-commercial use, with attribution

sources.name: morphology
sources.title: Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology v0.4, Arabic-script fork with root and lemma fixes (mustafa0x/quran-morphology)
sources.licence: GNU GPL (Quranic Arabic Corpus, corpus.quran.com) — attribution, verbatim

sources.name: qursim
sources.title: QurSim: related verse pairs from Ibn Kathir's tafsir (Sharaf & Atwell, LREC 2012) — the similarity answer key
sources.licence: Research data published by the authors; cite Sharaf & Atwell (2012)

sources.name: qul-topics
sources.title: QUL ayah topics (Tarteel) — ~2,500 topics incl. the Stories branch; the clustering reference
steps: Create a free account at https://qul.tarteel.ai and sign in.
Open https://qul.tarteel.ai/resources/ayah-topics, pick the 'Topics' card, Download → sqlite.
Save (or unzip) the .db / .sqlite file as data/raw/qul/topics.db, then run `just check-data`.
sources.licence: QUL resources, per the resource card on qul.tarteel.ai
